content:
The image shows a dried, shriveled, and brown leaf that appears to have died and fallen off the plant. The dieback starts from the tip and progresses downwards. This pattern of necrosis and tissue death, causing the leaf to dry up and look dead, is characteristic of "Die_Back" disease. There are no signs of powdery white spots (Powdery_Mildew), dark, sunken lesions typical of Anthracnose, or a black, soot-like coating (Sooty_Mould).
